headline: Flagler stand a match from an unbeaten conference season
dek: Flagler won at Lander on Saturday and go into their last conference match without a defeat; Georgia Southwestern, still without a conference win, visit on Monday. Their only loss all season came outside the conference, at Florida Southern in September.
displaced_by: The old dek's trip to Lander has now been played and won, so 'head to Lander today' is no longer true. The newer story is that Flagler go into their last conference match unbeaten.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Flagler's 38 goals are more than USC Aiken and Georgia Southwestern have scored between them, and twelve different players have shared them.

wire.line: The top of the table is settled: no one left can catch Flagler, who have yet to lose to a conference side.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches have passed their date with no published result, every one of them from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Middle Georgia State have conceded 48 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, while scoring 29.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Javier Gongora Andres has scored eleven of Middle Georgia State's 29 goals from 52 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Finn Weigelt has scored eleven of Flagler's 38 goals from 36 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Isaac Calderon has scored nine of North Georgia's 39 goals from 44 shots.

last_match.line: Flagler have beaten Lander home and away, and have won every conference match since the September draw with North Georgia.

next_match.line: The meeting at Clayton State earlier this month was drawn, and Lander have lost every match since.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
